title: Truemetrics (YC S23) Is Hiring in Berlin – GTM Lead
summary: Truemetrics, a Y Combinator Summer 2023 cohort company based in Berlin, is hiring a Founding GTM Lead to build and execute their go-to-market strategy. This is an early-stage startup hiring announcement posted on Hacker News.
problem_solved: Recruiting a key leadership role to drive market penetration and revenue growth for an early-stage YC-backed startup.
why_valuable: Provides an opportunity to join a YC-backed company in Berlin as an early team member with equity upside and significant responsibility.
